headline: Council hears testimony on coastal hotel zoning resolution and Lahaina rebuilding

meeting.summary: Testifiers addressed Resolution 26-129, on possible hotel zoning for some apartment-zoned coastal properties, and Lahaina town rebuilding. Bill 85 would allow Planning Commission hearing notices in any countywide publication. The Council recessed with no objections.
meeting.recap: Seven members were present at roll call, enough for a quorum.[[0:04:57]] Testifiers honored the late Michelle Santos for mentoring young women through the Miss Maui Filipina Scholarship Pageant.[[0:10:43]] The Office of Hawaiian Affairs opposed Resolution 26-129, which could move apartment-zoned coastal properties toward hotel zoning.[[1:14:40]] A testifier said Lahaina town remains largely unbuilt more than three years after the August 8, 2023 fires.[[1:40:10]] Resolution 26-146 settles a workers' compensation claim for work injuries in August 2023.[[2:35:07]] Bill 85 would let Planning Commission hearing notices run in any countywide publication, not only newspapers.[[2:47:52]]
decided: The Council took a recess with no objections.
meeting.next: County Communication 26-25 will come back when the Council takes up Committee Report 26-68. The mayor's office said that after Council approval of the sister city resolution, it would notify the city and plan a ceremonial acceptance.

moments.q: Vice chair recalls a former governor's advice: “remember, you work for the people.”
Family thanks the Council: “a huge mahalo for this incredible honor for my sister.”
Attorney warns litigation will start if properties are left out of the process.
A council member on the past weekend: “we got a firestorm again and we lost power again.”

issues.oneLine: Resolution 26-129 would send some apartment-zoned coastal properties forward for possible permanent hotel zoning.
issues.next: A proposed amendment to the resolution was postponed until the Council takes up Committee Report 26-68.
issues.brief: The Realtors Association of Maui testified in support of the resolution.[[#1]] One resident opposed the resolution, saying “we are in a housing crisis.”.[[#2]]

issues.oneLine: A testifier said Lahaina town remains largely unbuilt more than three years after the August 8, 2023 fires.
issues.why: The testifier said long delays are causing a mental health crisis among residents.
issues.brief: The testifier said people need jobs and it is time to rebuild downtown Lahaina.[[#1]] The testifier urged using fiscal year 2028 and rainy day funds to speed permits in Lahaina town and put utilities underground.[[#2]]
